But first…..

🎉NOAH + HALEY ARE FINALLY MARRIED WOO!!!!🎉

I’ve known Noah since middle school, and we had intermingled friend groups from middle school through college

☀️I say this because one of the biggest things Haley touched on was the idea of an invisible string connection her and Noah with all the people around them that knew them separately BEFORE Haley and Noah met (if that makes sense!?)

I met Haley sometime last year (virtually) and immediately could see how incredible of a person she is and the true love connection between them (it was the most special thing to see!!). Crazy how God works through others to bring others together!!

So yeah when they asked me to photograph their wedding, it was an immediate yes 🤍

The day was focused on Christ, love, family, connections, and that invisible string idea. We started with a beautiful rehearsal dinner celebration on Friday night 

Saturday — the fun began! Thankfully the smoke around Chicago settled!!! 

Getting ready, emotional first looks, prayer, a beautiful ceremony, newlywed photos, reception, ice cream bar, and an epic dance party to finish off a weekend worth of celebration

Just look through the photos. You can just HEAR the joy radiating off both of them🤍

Congrats to you two again, and thank you for having me document such a wonderful weekend for you both
